lessons_used: Predictions were mostly too high for neutral or negative changes, but too low for winning tests (sign_in notification and adoption new_flow).
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
No clear effect was seen for sign_in reorder changes across 2 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect in 2 tests and made performance worse in 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made finish worse in 1 test and showed no clear effect in 1 test.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path reorder and sign_in notification (1 test each), while adoption new_flow had mixed results across 2 tests (1 worse, 1 won).

candidates.title: Home Intro Split Screen Companion Overview
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split layout separating companion greeting copy from immediate desktop interaction buttons.
candidates.why: Finish stage has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (64.8%) and a very high mean duration of 5815s. A clear split screen structure reduces ambiguity at the final step.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Companion to Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Your companion is ready! Select how you would like to start interacting on your workspace.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of home_intro screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish drops 35.2% of users, but past redesigns consistently underperformed or lowered conversion.

candidates.title: Companion Initialization Status Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated initialization status screen before waiting to provide visual system checks prior to companion desktop loading.
candidates.why: Home phase duration averages 2336s, and support reported instances of pet not rendering on desktop (3 emails). Transparent loading feedback keeps users engaged while assets initialize.

new_initialization_status.headline: Initializing Workspace Integration
new_initialization_status.body: Setting up companion animations and desktop overlay components...

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new initialization status screen inside onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from funnel and 3 support mails, but adding new screens historically adds friction.

candidates.title: Pet Trait & Persona Match Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a stage layout with interactive persona matching cards within the pet selection phase to guide companion choice.
candidates.why: Adoption stage conversion dropped to 71.7% with median 89s and mean 1017s. Structuring choices via personality traits helps undecided users choose faster.

pick_friend.headline: Match With Your Ideal Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select traits that fit your daily desktop routines and workflow style.

guard.reason: Valid layout update to pick_friend stage layout.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 28.3% of users; adoption new_flow has a mixed record with one previous winning test.

candidates.title: Sign-In Deferred to Adoption Completion
candidates.change: Move sign-in screen to take place after adoption certificate creation right before waiting.
candidates.why: Sign-in early in onboarding has a mean duration of 567s. Moving authentication after pet adoption lets users build affinity before committing to account registration.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign-in step after adoption certificate creation.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign_in showed no clear positive effect across 2 previous tests (-1.2% average).

candidates.title: Account Continuity Assurance Copy
candidates.change: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in protects existing pets and progress.
candidates.why: 8 support emails mentioned pets going missing or account resetting upon signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect & Sync Your Pet
sign_in.body: Signing in links your pet companion securely to your cloud account so your progress is never lost.
sign_in.hint: Use the email tied to your previous pet to retain existing customization and data.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Background Rendering Completion Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification options and time estimation on the waiting screen so users know when companion generation is complete.
candidates.why: The waiting step in home has a very long mean time of 2336s, indicating users minimize the app while waiting for pet assets to render.

waiting.headline: Rendering Your Desktop Companion...
waiting.body: You can safely minimize this window. We'll send a notification as soon as your pet is ready on your screen.

guard.reason: Valid addition of notifications and time estimate to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high mean wait time (2336s); notification changes previously delivered strong positive lift.

candidates.title: Path Selection Time Estimate Hint
candidates.change: Display explicit duration estimates and explanatory hints on the path selection screen.
candidates.why: Choose path has a median duration of 8s but a mean duration of 514s, indicating significant decision latency for hesitant users.

choose_path.hint: Setup takes under 2 minutes. You can adjust all preferences later from settings.

guard.reason: Valid addition of duration estimate and hint on choose_path screen.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint addition to resolve high mean time vs low median time on path selection.

candidates.title: Choose Path Stage Focus Layout
candidates.change: Switch the choose_path layout to a stage layout to highlight key differences between onboarding paths.
candidates.why: 76.2% conversion with a high mean time (514s) shows users get stalled comparing options at the start of onboarding.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign for choose_path screen.

candidates.score_note: Layout and structural changes to early steps have tended to yield neutral or negative results.

candidates.title: Starter Accessory Completion Reward
candidates.change: Add a starter accessory completion badge component on the home intro screen to motivate finishing onboarding.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is high (64.8% conversion). Giving an immediate reward incentive boosts final onboarding completion.

home_intro.headline: Onboarding Complete! Collect Your Companion Starter Kit
home_intro.body: Claim your pet's first interactive desktop item to finish setup.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Free', violating the rule against mentioning free extras or prices.

candidates.title: Photo Processing Progress Steps
candidates.change: Add progress indicators and step counters to the upload_photos screen to keep users informed during custom pet uploads.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has a mean time of 1017s and 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or stalling.

upload_photos.hint: Processing high-quality artwork assets for desktop rendering...

guard.reason: Valid addition of progress indicators and step counters to upload_photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from funnel time and 3 support tickets; informative feedback reduces drop-off.
